description: subset_mobius mod.rs: original algorithm and independent finite correspondence
cost: k*n mask visits, k*n/2 modular subtractions, n normalizations; O(n log n) time and O(1) extra space, n<=2^20. No primality test, inversions, allocation or speed claim.
forward: For n=2^k nonempty,m>0, y[S]=sum_{T subset S} (-1)^(popcount(S xor T)) x[T] mod m. Normalize then subtract each bit-cleared coefficient from bit-set coefficients, once per coordinate. This is subset-lattice Mobius inversion, inverse to subset zeta over every Z/mZ.
inverse: Typed behavior complement and ambiguous reverse reconstruction in model.md
limitations: Finite tests are not a proof; allocation refusal not injected; macros opaque and semantic AST absent
